cards.answer: Kayle is a marksman/mage whose attacks gain speed, range and magic-damage waves as she levels. Her damage scales with AD and AP, and her ultimate grants temporary invulnerability.
cards.counterplay: Pressure her before her ranged upgrades, avoid extended attack trades, and save burst until invulnerability ends.

citations.quote: Name: Kayle. Official role tags: Marksman, Mage.

Level 1 - Zealous: Kayle's basic attacks on-attack grant her stacking attack speed, and at maximum stacks she also gains move speed.
Level 6 - Arisen: Kayle gains range and becomes a ranged champion.
Level 11 - Aflame: While at maximum stacks, Kayle's basic attacks launches a fire wave that deals magic damage.

cards.answer: Divine Ascent: Attacks stack attack speed and grant movement speed at maximum stacks. Kayle becomes ranged at level 6; at level 11, attacks at maximum stacks launch magic-damage waves. At level 16, she permanently has maximum stacks and gains more attack range.
cards.counterplay: Pressure her early and disengage when she builds attack stacks.

cards.answer: Radiant Blast: A forward projectile expands on hitting an enemy, dealing magic damage, slowing targets hit and reducing their armor and magic resistance.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the projectile and avoid standing close behind its target; back off while your resistances are reduced.

cards.answer: Celestial Blessing: Kayle heals herself and an allied champion, granting both a brief movement speed boost.
cards.counterplay: Account for the heal and speed boost before committing to a chase.

citations.quote: Active: Kayle heals herself and an allied champion. Additionally, both of them gains move speed for a brief time.

facts.claim: Kayle heals herself and an allied champion, granting both a brief movement speed boost.

cards.answer: Starfire Spellblade: Attacks passively deal bonus magic damage. Activating it resets her attack timer and empowers her next attack with extra magic damage based on the target's missing health; before she becomes ranged, this attack can reach at range. From level 11, the empowered attack also explodes onto surrounding enemies.
cards.counterplay: Respect her reach even early, retreat when low on health, and spread away from her attack target.

cards.answer: Divine Judgment: Kayle makes herself or an allied champion temporarily invulnerable. When the protection ends, swords strike around the protected target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Hold burst until the protection ends and move away from the protected target before the swords strike.
